ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.

4. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A mixture of two liquids

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmful effects of? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmful effects of.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmful effects of.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmful effects of.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Harmful effects of.

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

13. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Exploring weather? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Exploring weather.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Exploring weather.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Exploring weather.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Exploring weather.

16. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. watt (W)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Light environment School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and Sky its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Exploring weather and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Uses of water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
